scenarios.name: Audit round-trip against the real API
scenarios.given: config/jev.json enabled:true with both features audit in a temp plugin root, and a real TYPESAFE_API_KEY in env
scenarios.when: the real craftflow_jev_prompt_hint.py hook is fed a UserPromptSubmit payload with a DEBUG-shaped prompt
scenarios.then: the hook exits 0 with empty stdout and events.jsonl gains exactly 2 telemetry rows (feature in {routing, skill}) containing no prompt text
scenarios.expected: exit 0; 2 telemetry rows; no prompt text

scenarios.name: Session-check round-trip: consent request -> granted -> canary activation -> silent repeat -> canary failure
scenarios.given: a temp project + plugin root, config/jev.json starting at enabled:false/consent.status:unset, a real TYPESAFE_API_KEY in env, and a synthetic session_id
scenarios.when: the real craftflow_jev_session_check.py SessionStart hook fires four times (with one craftflow_jev_setup.py --record-consent call in between) across two session_ids, the fourth firing using a garbage API key
scenarios.then: firing 1 injects the consent-request tag + exact recorder commands and records already_asked_consent:true; --record-consent granted sets consent.status=granted on disk; firing 2 runs a real canary call and writes active:true with an activation note; firing 3 (same session_id) is silent per DD-8; firing 4 (new session_id, garbage key) writes active:false with a non-empty reason and a failure warning
scenarios.expected: exit 0; consent-request tag + recorder commands on firing 1; consent.status==granted after CLI; active:true + activation note on firing 2; empty additionalContext on firing 3; active:false + failure warning on firing 4
